{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Earth Monkey|kanji=戊申|romaji=tsuchinoe saru|onyomi=bojin|p=wùshēn|w=wu-shen|mi=u⁵⁵ ʂən|y=mou6 san1|j=mou6 san1|ci=mɐu ʂɐn|mc=məu ʂin|oc-bs=mə ʂin}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Earth Monkey''' (戊申, ''tsuchinoe saru''; onyomi ''bojin'') is the 45th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 45th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Fire Goat|ja|丁未|1=Yin Fire Goat}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Earth Rooster|ja|己酉|1=Yin Earth Rooster}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''戊'' is Yang Earth, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''申'' (Monkey) is Yang Metal; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Earth Monkey (戊申)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): wùshēn
** Cantonese (Jyutping): mou6 san1
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: tsuchinoe-saru
*** On'yomi: bojin
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): musin (무신)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Mậu Thân

=== Events ===
* In {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|qid=Q3125096|lt=Meiji era|1=Meiji era}} 41 (1908), the {{ill|Wushen Edict|ja|戊申詔書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wushen Edict|1=Q17641335|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q17641335}} was issued.
* In 1968, the Tet Offensive took place during the {{ill|Vietnam War|en|Vietnam War|qid=Q8740|lt=Vietnam War|1=Vietnam War}}. In Vietnamese, it is referred to as {{Unicode|Sự kiện Tết Mậu Thân}} (the Wushen New Year Incident).

==Months of Yang Earth Monkey==
In years whose last digit in the Western calendar is 2 or 7 (corresponding to the heavenly stems {{ill|Ren|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren}} and {{ill|Ding|ja|丁|1=Hinoto (丁)|lt=Hinoto (丁)|2=ja|3=丁|4=zh|5=丁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ding}}), the month of July is designated as the month of Wushen. (Note that in this context, “month” may refer to a lunar month or a seasonal period [from {{ill|Liqiu|en|Liqiu|qid=Q1147421|lt=Risshū|1=Liqiu}} to the day before {{ill|Bailu (solar term)|en|Bailu (solar term)|qid=Q1191003|lt=Hakuro|1=Bailu (solar term)}}].)

==Days of Yang Earth Monkey==
=== Date Selection ===
The day of Wushen is the 16th day (the final day) of the {{ill|Tengitenjō|ja|天一天上|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengitenjō|ja_comment=天一神|1=Tenitsu-shin|2=ja|3=天一神|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11442153}}.
